job.rawJd:
JOIN BUBBLE
Title: Director, Product Design
Compensation Range: $200K-$259K; offers equity
Location: Hybrid NYC

We built Bubble with a clear mission: to empower everyone to create software. Our AI visual development platform lets anyone, from first-time entrepreneurs to enterprise teams, take an idea from prompt to fully functional, scalable app across web, iOS, and Android. With over 6 million users in more than 100 countries, Bubble is breaking down the barriers to entrepreneurship and innovation worldwide.

Our Product
Bubble is a fully visual AI app builder that lets people move beyond prototypes and launch real apps. Users can chat with AI for speed and edit directly for control. Bubble's visual editor supports design, privacy rules, programming logic, web and native mobile editing, hosting, security, database management, and automatic scaling.

About the team
Bubble has four product designers and is growing the team with two open roles and more growth planned. Product Design owns the end-to-end experience of building apps on Bubble, including the home screen, the agent that helps users create and edit apps, and the editor where users design apps, define workflows, and manage data. The team drives the UX, user research and testing, and UI for these experiences.

About the role
Bubble is seeking a Director of Product Design to lead the product design team. The role reports to the VP, Product and is responsible for building the team, putting design processes in place, refining the design system, and iterating on the design vision. The role will help make Bubble easy to learn and intuitive from idea through production-ready app.

In this role you will lead product designers, identify development and growth opportunities, and provide regular coaching and feedback; drive product design hiring by defining the hiring and interview plan and leading interviews; establish product design best practices and processes across discovery and delivery; help the team explore and validate designs efficiently and scope and iterate on launches; refine Bubble's design system and apply it consistently; lead by example through user conversations, cross-functional collaboration, opportunity identification, and idea validation; and refine the product vision, ideal customer profile, and ideal user journey through research and validation.

About you
10+ years of product design experience on challenging UX problems, including PLG SaaS. 5+ years leading design teams, ideally scaling teams in a high-growth startup. Interest in AI and no-code development, with prior experience a nice-to-have. A track record of recruiting senior talent and developing high-performing teams. Deep experience guiding teams through user research, design exploration and refinement, and iteration. A passion for design best practices and systems that help teams scale. The ability to make pragmatic prioritization, scope, and design decisions while balancing user needs, design vision, and business objectives.

Compensation
The estimated salary range is $200,000 to $259,000. Actual pay is based on skills, qualifications, experience, and market demand.

Location
Bubble is currently considering candidates who are authorized to work in the United States and are within the New York City metro area. Relocation assistance is available to candidates interested in moving to the area.

Benefits include health coverage, 401(k) matching, wellness and work-enablement stipends, generous PTO, and a sabbatical program. Bubble encourages candidates to apply even if they do not meet every qualification.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Director, Product Design role at Bubble. My background spans product design, UX research, design systems, client strategy, and hands-on AI product delivery. The common thread is making complex tools easier to understand, use, and improve.

At Kinesso, I joined product design as the second hire and later served as Director, Experience & Innovation. I helped scale the function from 2 to 30 people across the United States and Poland while supporting enterprise products used by 7,000+ people across 22 brands. I also built a UX research discipline across more than 20 products so teams had a repeatable way to interview users, test prototypes, share findings, and bring feedback into product decisions.

Design systems were another major part of that work. I led UX and system strategy for analytics, dashboard building, brand theming, reusable components, navigation, and personalization. The portfolio shows how research changed product behavior, how shared standards helped design and development work together, and how the system stayed useful as the suite and team grew.

My current work brings that foundation into AI products. I lead discovery, product strategy, UX, AI workflow design, front-end and backend decisions, demo readiness, and client iteration through working prototypes. That hands-on loop has made me especially interested in Bubble's challenge: giving people the speed of AI while preserving enough structure and control to build something real.

My route into product design is less conventional than a 10-year design-only title sequence. The direct record is nearly eight years in UX, product design, and experience leadership, supported by earlier digital client work and 15 years across complex delivery. It also does not document formal ownership of team recruiting or a five-year coaching record. What I can show is the work of building a design function, creating research and system practices, setting standards, and staying close to users and delivery.

Bubble needs a leader who can make a powerful platform feel learnable without flattening what it can do. I would welcome the chance to talk about the team, the product vision, and where my experience could be useful.

resume.summary: Product design and experience leader with nearly eight years in UX and product design, backed by 15 years across digital delivery, client strategy, and AI implementation. I scaled a product design team from 2 to 30, built research and design-system practices across 20+ products, and led enterprise UX for platforms used by 7,000+ people across 22 brands. Today I connect research, design systems, team growth, and hands-on product delivery through working AI products.
